The '''T100 Dual Power Absorber''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] component meant to raise a Podracer's defense, making the vessel more durable.<ref name="Guide" /> During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]],<ref name="RR2" /> [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], a [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]], sold Power Absorbers, among other parts, to [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="RR" /> The T100 was outclassed by [[Phase 3 Carbon Plating]], and sold for roughly 900 or more [[Trugut/Legends|truguts]].<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
The T100 Dual Power Absorber was first mentioned in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'', and was available as a Podracer upgrade that players could purchase. The plating was never visible to the player.<ref name="RR" /> The upgrade was mentioned again in the game's [[Star Wars: Racer Revenge: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]]. An exact price is difficult to figure out, due to the fact that the price of different parts will fluctuate depending on how many upgrades have been previously purchased. For each Podracer statistic category, there are nineteen upgrade levels, and the T100 is the eleventh defense upgrade, where a base price of 900 truguts can be roughly established.<ref name="Guide" />
